text_block_list.text:
Early one morning, Эль Кондор Паса
comes running
up to me as I'm making
my way to the academy.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Sí! I got up with the sun today!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: I'm ridin' high and shiny just like the sun!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Watch out, Trainer, or you might get
burned!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
The flames of passion are burnin' outta
control!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса
